title: Census and verify Taichung–Changhua 500碗 × Bib Gourmand candidates
question: Across Taichung and Changhua, which restaurants surfaced by 2026 500碗 or the 2026 Taichung MICHELIN Bib Gourmand are currently operating, still serve the relevant food, show durable recognition or cross-guide signal, and remain genuinely worth allocating a meal slot to after logistics and negative-evidence checks?
acceptance_criteria: Entity-resolve the complete latest-2026 Taichung and Changhua 500碗 corpus and 2026 Taichung Bib Gourmand corpus.
Preserve aliases, branch ambiguity, source-rendering defects, and unresolved duplicates explicitly.
Backfill 2023–2025 500碗 and prior MICHELIN retention for current candidates and notable former high-award shops.
For high-information candidates, verify current operating status, relevant dish availability, price, hours, queue/sell-out risk, and ordering friction.
Run a deliberate recent negative-evidence pass before a trip-worthiness conclusion.
Do not treat Changhua's lack of Bib Gourmand as negative evidence because Changhua is outside the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Taiwan scope.
Produce geography/daypart clusters only from sufficiently fresh verified candidates.
